name: Upside-Down Chocolate Ganache S'mores Pie
desc: A small graham cracker pie filled with milk and dark chocolate ganache and marshmallow meringue, flipped to serve.

source.title: Upside-Down Chocolate Ganache S'mores Pie
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 1/4 cups graham cracker crumbs (16-18 full sheets)
2 large egg whites, from pasteurized eggs

steps: Grind the graham crackers to fine crumbs in a food processor if starting from whole crackers. Stir in the melted butter, brown sugar and salt.
Press 3/4 of the crumbs evenly into the bottom and up the sides of a 6 in springform pan. Save the rest for the top.
Bake 10 min. Cool the crust completely, about 30 min.
Put both chocolates in a heatproof bowl. Heat the cream in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming and bubbling at the edges; do not boil.
Pour the hot cream over the chocolate, wait a few minutes, then stir until smooth. Stir in the vanilla and salt.
Pour the ganache into the cooled crust and refrigerate at least 1 hr, until set.
In a stand mixer, whip the egg whites until frothy. Add the sugar a little at a time while beating, then the salt and vanilla, and whip to stiff peaks.
Dollop the meringue over the chilled ganache and spread it out. Sprinkle the saved crumbs on top and pat down gently.
Release the springform and flip the pie upside down onto a plate to serve.
tips: For clean slices, warm a knife under hot water, dry it, then slice.

The meringue is never baked, so the whites need to come from pasteurized in-shell eggs. Without them, make a Swiss meringue: whisk the whites, sugar and salt in a bowl over simmering water until the mixture reaches 160°F, then whip to stiff peaks and add the vanilla.
